APIs explain and provide examples for the functions in a library. You should always refer to the API documentation when using a library. You should always aim to create API documentation when creating a library. One hallmark of when not to use a API is if the library is no longer maintained by developers. If you have a problem with the API documentation and the library is no longer maintained, you should consider implementing the function on your own or finding a different actively managed library to use instead.
